title: Small Hours
description: An original 3:31 wordless electronic track for twelve mouths. A five-note hook repeats over a two-step mouth beat while the chords change under it; in the breakdown one voice sings a slow melody alone, and at the end the same melody returns over the full beat before the piece settles in a major key.
